{{Top|leg}}
'''Attack Pattern Abbadon''' was a [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] tactic used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], being used under the precepts of [[Formation Aleph]]. It involves ordering all present Star Destroyers to close to full weapons range.

==History==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox|Lennox]] used this tactic to attack [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]] with his group of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]].
